svg.title: 3D-full — Takeoff elbow with easy-bend elbow
svg.desc: Individual fitting. Prepared from a tight approved-source crop after full-assembly attempts changed the geometry. Compound elbow, inner and outer bends, seam and shallow rectangular outlet visually match the source crop. Retains a short schematic parent duct fragment below the far-side branch; parent ends are completed boundaries. Generic source artwork shared across corner variants; artwork does not distinguish full, tight and mitered configuration. High-resolution raster in SVG.
